settings.label: Commissions
settings.statement: One piece, for one person, made once.
settings.text: Outside the collections, the house makes single pieces to the wearer — wedding sets above all. Nothing here is listed or held in stock. It begins with a conversation with Kamalam and ends at the loom.

settings.title: The conversation
settings.text: Write to us with the occasion and the date. Kamalam replies herself and, if the dates allow, a call is set. Tamil or English.

settings.title: Cloth and motif
settings.text: Together you settle the cloth, the border, the motif and the colour from the kara set. A sample of the border is woven and sent before anything is committed.

settings.title: The loom
settings.text: The veshti is woven by a named weaver at the unit. The kurta or shirt is cut to your measure. You are told when the warp goes on.

settings.title: Fitting and delivery
settings.text: One fitting, in Chennai or by measurement. Delivered by hand within Tamil Nadu; insured courier elsewhere. The piece carries the weaver's name and yours.

settings.title: The wedding set
settings.text: Veshti, kurta and angavastram as one set, in gold or tested zari, with motifs drawn for the family. Lead time and price are agreed after the first conversation.

settings.title: Capacity
settings.text: A few pieces a season, so that each has the time it needs. Dates are taken in order of the first conversation.

settings.title: Deposit
settings.text: A deposit on agreement of cloth and motif; the balance at fitting.

settings.title: Lead time
settings.text: Set in writing from sample approval. A wedding date too close to allow it cannot be taken.

settings.title: Price
settings.text: Quoted once, in writing, after step II. It does not change, and it is never discounted.

settings.label: Terms
settings.heading: What is agreed before the warp goes on
